ops.statement: Issue close is a separate step sequenced strictly after the merge is CONFIRMED, not after gate checks pass. Sequence: verify checks green, merge, verify main HEAD advanced, then close. Never batch the close with gate verification. When verifying checks green, read each non-required check row explicitly (e.g. pyright) — the `gh pr checks --watch` exit code only reflects required checks; a failing non-required check is invisible to watch exit 0.

ops.statement: A commander idle_notification does not distinguish done from stalled. Gate classification on artifact completeness: commit on branch AND open PR both present -> done; otherwise -> stalled (regardless of idle reason). Before classifying idle+uncommitted as a stall, check crew-runs.json for active crew agents — idle + uncommitted is NOT a stall if a crew is actively running for that work-id. Recovery for a stall = SendMessage return-and-continue with the same agent; do NOT kill and relaunch (idle/available means context is intact; two-agents-in-worktree risk otherwise). When a commander pattern-recurrently stalls at the push/PR/archive step across multiple nudge attempts (not just once), the Admiral should plan to own those closeout mechanics directly — the launch-order warning alone is insufficient.

ops.statement: Any residual / calibration / stability diagnostic computed over a self-weighted or smoothing predictor (drift fit, RTS smoother, kernel) MUST use leave-one-out (out-of-sample) prediction. A self-inclusive form pins the prediction to each point's own value and is structurally blind to the very failure it exists to detect (sigma-too-small / over-claiming, between-session instability). When a crew flags this class once, sweep the whole module for sibling diagnostics rather than fixing only the flagged instance. Apply the same LOO discipline to the TARGET variable in a supplant/evaluation test: a truth channel derived from the same signal family as the feature, or algebraically collinear with it, yields spuriously high LOO P — gate with P>=0.95-means-leakage. Also verify the truth OLS is full-rank; within-stint fixed-effects + tyre_life are collinear (lap_number = offset + tyre_life within a stint), so use driver or race fixed-effects for the fuel term.

ops.statement: Multi-hour batch compute must be Admiral-owned and OS-detached (e.g. PowerShell Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden, which survives all three fleet-doctrine kill vectors). A commander's harness-tracked background workers die when the subagent idles — guaranteed strand. Pattern: Admiral launches detached workers, records PIDs + state note, uses a durable watcher (Wait-Process) rather than a harness-tracked background; CLIs must be idempotent/resumable so partial runs continue. A commander may discover or diagnose batch scope, but must not be the one running multi-hour compute.
